thread:
Lina: quick flag — noticed onboarding sampleapp and both SDKs leak raw stack traces and inconsistent error fields. customers get a bare '500' or a huge dump that confuses support.

Omar: can you paste a short repro? which SDK versions?

Lina: repro: call /v1/chat with an invalid payload. JS (v1.2.3) responds with Error('500') and no structured data; Python (v0.9.8) raises ServerError with {'code':'server_error','message':'panic at line 42','trace':'...'} — sampleapp prints the trace directly to the UI.

Becca: that's bad for onboarding. we need an "actionable" contract that frontends can rely on. minimal required keys: code (stable enum), http_status, message (user-facing short), detail (dev-only, optional), retryable (bool), retry_after (secs|null), error_id (opaque). keep detail out of the default UI.

Tomas: proposed code enums: rate_limit, auth_expired, auth_insufficient_scope, transient_service, model_error, validation_error, unknown_error. Important: codes MUST be snake_case and stable.

Lina: also want a short human_action string for product teams e.g. 'Try again in 30s' or 'Reconnect account' so we avoid ad-hoc copy in apps.

Omar: on the SDK side: plan is to add typed exceptions/classes plus a small compatibility shim. JS will implement RedwoodError extending Error with fields {code,http_status,message,human_action,retryable,retry_after,error_id,detail}. Python will add dataclass exceptions with the same attributes and friendly __str__ that returns message only.

Becca: make sure the SDKs do NOT put full traces into message. message must be safe for end-user surfaces. detail may contain trace + headers for dev consoles only.

infra-bot: created issue #6123 "sdk: actionable error contract + sampleapp dev toggle" — https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/6123 :white_check_mark:

Tomas: mapping rules proposal:
- 401 -> auth_expired or auth_insufficient_scope (non-retryable)
- 403 -> auth_insufficient_scope (non-retryable)
- 429 -> rate_limit (retryable, include retry_after if present)
- 502/503/504 -> transient_service (retryable)
- model runtime 5xx -> model_error (non-retryable; show friendly fallback)
- payload 4xx -> validation_error (non-retryable; include field hints)
- fallback -> unknown_error (non-retryable, message 'Something went wrong')

Lina: small UX ask: sampleapp should show the human_action or message in the card, with a tiny "developer details" toggle that POSTs the error_id to our debug endpoint to fetch structured detail (only visible internally). do NOT include raw headers or tokens.

Omar: migration plan: 1) release SDKs that add fields but preserve Error.message for one release with a deprecation notice; 2) update sampleapp and docs; 3) emit telemetry field error_contract_version=v1; 4) after 90 days remove legacy reliance on message parsing.

Becca: tests we need: unit tests for each mapping, integration tests ensuring sampleapp default UI hides detail, and an e2e that simulates Retry-After header being honored by retry middleware. Also a small partner compatibility test where server sends x-error-code header that older clients can read.

Tomas: telemetry + logging: always emit code, http_status, error_id, and contract version. do NOT emit stack or PII. put trace_id in logs for internal correlation.

Lina: security note: make sure error_id is unpredictable and short-lived. avoid embedding user identifiers.

Omar: i'll own the JS change + sampleapp UI toggle. i'll add a tiny migration doc and a deprecation warning when Error.message is used by downstream code.

Becca: i'll take the python exceptions and the backend debug endpoint to serve detail based on error_id to internal users.

infra-bot: assigned GH #6123 to @Omar and @Becca. due: next Friday.

Tomas: quick implementation snippet for JS shim:
```js
// normalize network errors into RedwoodError
function normalizeError(resp, body) {
  const code = body?.code || resp.headers.get('x-error-code') || 'unknown_error'
  return new RedwoodError({
    code,
    http_status: resp.status,
    message: body?.message || 'Something went wrong',
    human_action: body?.human_action || null,
    retryable: !!body?.retryable,
    retry_after: body?.retry_after ?? null,
    error_id: body?.error_id || null,
    detail: null, // fetch via internal debug endpoint
  })
}
```

Lina: nice. one more ask: include small example copy strings for each code in the spec so product teams can pick approved messages. keeps onboarding copy consistent.

Omar: will add those to the issue. aiming for first PR by mid-week.

Becca: thanks all. this should make support and onboarding much smoother. :tada:
